name: Critical flow proof
description: Continuously prove one important user flow with rendered browser evidence and prompt retries when it fails.

parameters.label: Evaluation name
parameters.tooltip: Name the build that OpenOrbit creates for this recurring evaluation.

parameters.label: Browser base URL
parameters.tooltip: Public URL that Playwright opens while collecting browser evidence.

parameters.label: Critical flow name
parameters.placeholder: e.g. Sign in and complete checkout
parameters.tooltip: Short, stable name shown for this fixed evaluation case.

parameters.label: Start path
parameters.tooltip: Path opened first by the browser journey, relative to the browser base URL.

parameters.label: User actions
parameters.placeholder: e.g. Sign in, add an item, and complete checkout.
parameters.tooltip: The exact user actions or request used to exercise the target.

parameters.label: Success condition
parameters.placeholder: e.g. The confirmation page shows the completed order.
parameters.tooltip: Observable evidence required for this case to be considered successful.

parameters.label: Review focus
parameters.placeholder: e.g. clear recovery from a failed checkout
parameters.tooltip: The product behavior or experience that the repeated journey should prioritize.

parameters.label: AI model profile
parameters.tooltip: Select an existing AI model profile, or create one for this build.

runner.name: ${build_name} runner
runner.description: Continuously prove one important user flow with rendered browser evidence and prompt retries when it fails.

prompt_template.name: ${build_name} policy
prompt_template.content: Review rendered evidence for ${focus}. Preserve user safety, explain evidence, and propose only reversible improvements.

build.name: ${build_name}
build.purpose: Continuously prove one important user flow with rendered browser evidence and prompt retries when it fails.
